GET /coach/program/lessons/:id.body: Good questions open the passage instead of closing it. The program team pasted a few examples from an old handout into this lesson; parts of that handout carried HTML, and none of it does anything here. ![A question ladder diagram](/uploads/question-ladder.png) ## Three kinds of questions - **Observation:** what does the passage say? - **Interpretation:** what did it mean for the people who first heard it? - **Application:** what does it ask of us this week?
